bead.title: Wire objectlog hybrid server runtime
bead.description: Wire the runtime profile. Add ProjectionSpec::Hybrid { path }, parse PQUEUE_PROJECTION_BACKEND=hybrid using PQUEUE_SQLITE_PROJECTION_PATH, reject unsupported log pairings, and start objectlog/hybrid through ComposedBackend<ObjectLog, HybridProjectionStore, InProcessControlPlane> using ObjectLog::open_group_commit. Add a server flusher task for generic group commit using group_commit_flush_interval_ms and flush_tick. Preserve segment config, recovery-tail, debug segment telemetry, counters/evidence access, and queue bootstrap behavior. Update Helm/static validation and runtime docs. Out of scope: performance evidence beyond smoke tests.
bead.acceptance:
1. cargo test -p pqueue-server env_config -- --nocapture passes.
2. cargo test -p pqueue-server --test server objectlog_hybrid -- --nocapture passes.
3. bash scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh passes.
4. rg -n "hybrid" docs/deployment charts/pqueue scripts/ci crates/pqueue-server finds the wired profile.
5. cargo fmt --check passes.
